engine: A martial class with d10 Hit Die, all armor and shields, repeating crossbows, sidearms and siege tools. Dexterity governs ranged attacks; Constitution governs class DC/M and defensive techniques. No RP, ordinary spellcasting, Refrain or Dissonance engine. Names such as Divine Lockdown describe disciplined suppression; they do not grant divine magic.

Overwatch is an automatic Base engine at1. Bonus Action designate a visible15ft square within weapon range until start next regular turn. Once during that interval, spend your Reaction when a perceived enemy enters, moves inside, attacks an ally from, or reveals itself inside the zone. Make one legal ranged attack with ammunition and line of fire, normally1d8+DEX piercing. On hit choose Snare (Speed-10ft until end next turn), Bleed (1d4 at start next turn), or Push5ft (STR save negates push). Concealment still applies. Only one Overwatch zone; no extra Reaction. The optional Overwatch card upgrades this engine. At17 you may move5ft without opportunity attacks after its shot, once/round.

At5 automatically gain Palisade Deployment. Spend one carried barricade kit and an Action to erect a2-by1-tile wall in contiguous unoccupied ground within5ft. Height5ft, AC12, HP5+CON modifier minimum1, immunity psychic/poison; blocks movement and line of sight across its full height but can be climbed using10ft movement. One kit/use per encounter, two at13; a long rest with carpentry tools replenishes2 kits (carried maximum2, reusable parts have no resale value). Material is required; no conjuring. At most one intact wall, two at13. Old wall must be dismantled in1 minute before replacement beyond cap. Once per encounter an Action repairs a wall for M HP using spare parts; destruction does not refresh uses.

Palisade TierII at13 doubles wall HP and grants resistance to damage from area effects. Hold Position: while adjacent to your intact wall gain+1AC and+1saves. Brace Line: an ally immediately behind you relative to a ranged attacker, with your wall adjacent to both of you, has2 flat DR against that attacker. These bonuses do not stack with another Soldier wall; strongest flat DR applies. Full cover prevents attacks rather than granting an additional AC bonus.

Base1–2, Commander Arch3–9, then Champion/Artillerist/Tyrant Hero10–20. Palisade5 is automatic; Intercepting Shot has minimum6 and Fortify Zone9. Other cards require selection. There is no source automatic Arch capstone. At20 gain the new Final Command below, clearly a playtest addition. No spell or sustained technique may be used to obtain infinite ammunition, structures, actions or permanent healing.
workedExample: Soldier6, DEX16, CON16, PB3, S2, M3. Carry2 barricade kits and begin with one encounter deployment available.
Turn1 Action deploy a10-by5ft wall: kits2→1, encounter uses1→0, wallHP8. Bonus Action designate Overwatch. Standing adjacent grants+1AC/+1saves.
Enemy moves inside zone; Reaction attack hits for1d8+3. Choose Snare: Speed-10ft through end of its next turn. You cannot also use Intercepting Shot before your Reaction refreshes.
Turn2 use Covering Fire: one ranged attack with its printed rider. You cannot add an ordinary Attack Action. Renew Overwatch with Bonus Action; its next shot still needs your Reaction.

If the wall is destroyed, encounter deployment stays0. An intact wall could receive its once/encounter repair for3HP. After combat a new encounter still requires a carried kit; long rest restores at most2 kits.
balanceQuestions: Does Overwatch meaningfully influence enemy movement without deciding every turn?
Are finite barricade kits practical to track?
Do support actions compete fairly with attacking?
